announcement.titleZh: 记得闪卡 v2.3.6 更新
announcement.contentZh:
【优化】优化页面转场、菜单、弹窗和折叠区域的动画效果，并调整统计页等界面布局，操作更顺滑、信息更清晰。

【开发者测试】AI 制卡与改卡能力面向开发者测试，可前往「设置 → 开发者调试」查看申请方式并获取调试资格。
announcement.contentEn:
[Improved] Refined page transitions, menus, dialogs, disclosure animations, and selected layouts, including the Statistics page, for a smoother and clearer experience.

[Developer Preview] AI card creation and editing are available for developer testing. Open Settings → Developer Debug and follow the instructions to request access.
